newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel March economic performance index up 0.9 pct.
newsitem.headline: Israel March economic performance index up 0.9 pct.

text.p: Israel's economic performance or "S" index rose 0.9 percent in March after a 0.5 percent increase in February and a cumulative 1.9 percent decline in the previous three months, the Bank of Israel said on Wednesday.

The index is made up of three components: retail sales, which rose by two percent in March; imports, which rose by 14.3 percent in March after a 1.6 percent decline in February; and industrial production, which rose 0.7 percent in February. Note: figures for industrial production lag.
